pages.text: Every player is given one $(item)Shatter Totem$() the first time they join. It cannot be crafted and it cannot be destroyed.$(br2)Carry it, or place it in your base. A placed totem is where your upgrades and auras work from, so most players build their base around it.

Only one totem is ever yours by right, but you can hold others: any totem you steal becomes yours.$(br2)If you die to another player while carrying your totem, it is placed where you fell. A totem dropped on the ground places itself after a short while.
pages.title: Keeping it
